thread:
incident-bot: Pager fired - region=us-east-az6 - symptom=control-plane heartbeats unstable + serving node flapping. Severity P1. Link: https://internal.incident/1859991111 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Alert created: `AZ6_ControlPlane_HeartbeatMismatch` at 2026-02-12T02:18:31Z. Policy: infra-sre.

oncall-erin: ack. i'm on call. tagging @infra-sre-jamal and @eng-runtime-lee

infra-sre-jamal: looking. control plane leader flips roughly every 20-40s, kube-apiserver latencies up, nodes NotReady events increasing. pulling fabric metrics now.

eng-runtime-lee: we see serving-proxy 5xx spike in az6 (baseline ~0.3% → ~7.5% over 8m). stack traces show repeated `connection reset by peer` to model-shard-proxy, plus KV-cache miss surge.

ops-tim: any downstream user/customer impact?

cs-ana: CS reports multiple customers getting 502s/timeouts against generation endpoints. opening support cases; notifying enterprise contacts.

infra-sre-jamal: initial read: intermittent packet drops on layer2 for a subset of az6 racks causing kubelet heartbeats to fail and pod churn. validating NIC error counters and TOR telemetry.

eng-runtime-lee: kv-cache evictions spiking -> cache miss storms -> CPU spin and longer GPU attach. quantized variant fallback might reduce CPU/GPU attach contention.

incident-bot: Reminder: if unacknowledged in 2m escalate to VP infra (ack received).

oncall-erin: Jamal/Lee — propose immediate mitigation options?

infra-sre-jamal: options: (A) Divert traffic away from az6 to other us-east AZs via routing plane (fast, reduces capacity); (B) Apply autoscaler hold on az6 to avoid thrash; (C) Drain and replace suspect worker NICs (hardware ops). I recommend A + B now.

eng-runtime-lee: agree to A+B. also suggest switching heavy models to compatible q8 quantized variant `rwd-xl-q8` in us-east to reduce attach/CPU cost post-diversion.

ops-tim: proceed with diversion. include exact commands and expected timeline. we need ETA to rollback if issues.

infra-sre-jamal: executing routing divert — command below:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://routing-api.internal/v1/route/divert" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"from_zone":"us-east-az6","to_zone":"us-east-az5","percentage":100}'
```

eng-runtime-lee: applying model variant fallback for region us-east:
```json
POST /v1/config/rollout
{ "model_family": "rwd-xl-gen", "fallback_variant": "rwd-xl-q8", "scope": "us-east", "activate_immediately": true }
```

incident-bot: Routing job started (id=rtd-1859) by infra-sre-jamal.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement logged by oncall-erin at 2026-02-12T02:19:12Z.

oncall-erin: performing step 1 now. I'll monitor errors and traffic distribution.

(>90s) infra-sre-jamal: diversion completed — ~90% of az6 traffic now routed to az5. client errors decreasing. az6 internal agents still noisy.

eng-runtime-lee: model fallback active: region-wide switch to q8 variants for affected families. observed global 5xx drop from ~3% to ~0.8%. az6 internal-only error rate ~3.7%.

cs-ana: CS confirms most impacted customers are seeing restored traffic. one large account saw degraded throughput for ~10 minutes; outreach done, customer accepts follow-up postmortem.

ops-tim: monitor az5 tail latency for next 60-120 minutes; add temporary throttles if bursts appear.

oncall-erin: applying autoscaler hold on az6 to stabilize pods. command used:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://k8s-api.internal/namespace/serving/annotate" -d '{"autoscaler":"hold"}'
```

infra-sre-jamal: autoscaler hold confirmed. starting NIC and TOR checks in az6 racks — found elevated CRC and packet drop counters on two NICs. opening support ticket with cloud provider (ticket: CS-998772). hardware ops ETA ~45-60m.

eng-runtime-lee: sharing trimmed logs for context:
```
[2026-02-12T02:12:55Z] proxy=svc-3 endpoint=10.1.6.22 err="connection reset by peer"
[2026-02-12T02:13:25Z] kvcache eviction spike: 85% -> 60%
```

pm-ravi: threshold — if >10 customers or >15m impact, we need a public status note. CS, draft a short status update now.

cs-ana: drafting status page entry and targeted emails for affected enterprise customers, will publish in 10-15m.

incident-bot: Please convert this thread into an incident report using template `incident-template/az-outage` and start a timeline.

oncall-erin: stabilization achieved for user-facing requests. next actions: replace faulty NICs, validate fabric vendor logs, roll node replacements in az6, disable autoscaler hold only after metrics normalize. Jamal owns hardware ops; Lee owns model quality checks.

infra-sre-jamal: hardware ticket created. will coordinate with provider for NIC swap and TOR verification. will update in 30-45m or earlier.

eng-runtime-lee: kicked off regression checks on model responses for q8 fallback — quick sample looks fine; will run full eval suite and report regressions if any.

ops-tim: if hardware ops slip past 60m, prepare plan to partially reintegrate az6 in controlled way to spread load.

oncall-erin: follow-ups assigned:
- jamal: NIC replacements + confirm NIC CRC metrics cleared
- lee: run eval suite + monitor inference quality for 2h
- cs-ana: status page + customer comms in 15m
- pm-ravi: coordinate enterprise comms

pm-ravi: thanks. include vendor timeline and hardware ticket reference in the postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager resolved: manual resolution by oncall-erin at 2026-02-12T02:29:05Z. Convert to incident and set severity to P1 if customer impact confirmed. :white_check_mark:

oncall-erin: closing mitigation thread. will reopen if hardware fix doesn't resolve NIC errors. thanks team. :clap:
